name: Belle-whisper-large-v2-zh
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A full fine-tune of openai/whisper-large-v2 on AISHELL-1/2, WenetSpeech and HKUST at 16 kHz, merged to full 1.543B weights - same config.json and tensor set as the base. Not a new base model. Recorded because the card's single CER(%) table prints the base as its own row in the same columns: aishell_1 2.549 vs 8.818, aishell_2 3.746 vs 6.183, wenetspeech_net 8.503 vs 12.343, wenetspeech_meeting 14.598 vs 26.413, HKUST_dev 16.289 vs 31.917 - all five lower. Lower is better, so those are wins. Card caveat: the AISHELL-2 and WenetSpeech sets here are the public dev/test releases the community uses, and the fine-tuning data overlaps them, so the 30-70% relative claim is in-domain. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2023-12-19. Sibling BELLE-2/Belle-whisper-large-v3-zh is already a record; this is the large-v2 build.
